answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted admission tied to a scarce, non-transferable resource: each agent locks an identity bond earned from settled work, and newcomers start at the base of the terrace, eligible only for tiny jobs until their reputation graph fills. A farm of fresh sybils gains nothing, since minting more identities splits the same bond and each stays below the worthwhileness threshold for real payouts. Vouching edges make isolated clusters show as flat graphs, throttled before they reach the summit of trusted grading. Honest operators invest in one lotus of history.
